name: baseline
description: Shipped defaults. Surface forms an English-speaking operator commonly uses to correct, stop, constrain, accept and refer. Structural rules are not here: they live in code and carry no dial.

correction_tier1.pattern: ^(no|nope)\b|\bwrong\b|\bthat'?s not\b|\bnot what i\b|\bi said\b|\bi'?m saying\b|\bi meant\b|\bwhy are you\b|\byou just\b|\bi did ?n'?o?t\b|\bdid ?n'?o?t ask\b|\bi told you\b

correction_tier2.pattern: \b(again|as i said|i already|this is the (second|third|fourth) time)\b

expansion_constraint.pattern: \b(from now on i|i will always|going forward i)\b

expansion_scope.pattern: \b(i also (updated|changed|modified|edited|touched|documented|refactored)|also updated|while i was (at it|there)|took the liberty)\b

pointer_operation.pattern: \b(after ci|before merge|on push|at release|after the merge)\b

reconstruction.pattern: \b(to recap|restating|as i said before|where we left off|here is where we are)\b

referent.pattern: \b(i mean|to be clear|the one i|as in|by that i mean)\b

release.pattern: \bnever ?mind\b|\bdisregard\b|\bscratch that\b|\bforget (that|about|it)\b|\bignore what i said\b|\byou (can|may|should) (now )?(drop|stop|ignore|forget|skip)\b|\bno longer (applies|needed|necessary|required|relevant|matters)\b|\b(drop|lift|cancel|withdraw) (that|the|this) (rule|constraint|requirement|restriction|scope|limit)\b|\b(that|this) (rule|constraint|requirement|restriction) (is|no longer) (lifted|gone|off|applies)\b

reset.pattern: \b(context clear|clear context|model switch|new chat)\b|\bhand(ing)? (this|it|things|the session|the work) off to (a |another )?new (session|context|agent)\b|\b(start|open|spin up|move to|switch to|hand off to)( a| another)? new session\b

scope.pattern: (^|[^\w-])only\b|\b(in scope|out of scope|scope|limited to|nothing else|just the|do not touch)\b

stop.pattern: ^stop\b|\bstop\s*[.!]|\b(you must stop|stop after|stop here|hard stop|nothing else|wait for me|wait for instructions|do not perform (any )?follow[ -]?up|no follow[ -]?up)\b
